subject.title: fix(shared): bound ignore-file reads during workspace scans

question: Should workspace ignore-file loading silently skip `.gitignore`, `.ignore`, and `.fdignore` files over 4 MiB to avoid unbounded memory reads, accepting the rare compatibility change for existing very large ignore files?
rationale: The patch is a narrow security/stability hardening, but repository policy treats compatibility-affecting fallback/default behavior as a maintainer decision even when CI and tests are green.

options.title: Accept bounded skip
options.body: Land the PR as-is and accept that over-cap ignore files are treated like unreadable ignore files during workspace scans.

options.title: Require a diagnostic policy
options.body: Ask for a warning or other visible diagnostic before merge so operators can discover when a huge ignore file is skipped.

options.title: Choose a different cap policy
options.body: Pause the PR until maintainers choose a larger cap, no cap, or another behavior for very large ignore files.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded skip
recommendation.body: Land the PR as-is and accept that over-cap ignore files are treated like unreadable ignore files during workspace scans.
